scripts.build: bun run build:compute && mkdir -p vendor vendor/trust && cp node_modules/@contentauth/c2pa-web/dist/resources/c2pa_bg.wasm vendor/c2pa_bg.wasm && cp trust/C2PA-TRUST-LIST.pem trust/ITL-anchors.pem trust/store.cfg trust/meta.json vendor/trust/
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run stage && wrangler pages deploy .deploy-stage --project-name=c2pa-viewer
scripts.test: bun scripts/golden.mjs --check && bun run test:parity && bun run test:openapi
